description: FAULT-S4-005 Step-3 full-ledger audit — shrink-only remediation register for pre-existing provenance_kind:proof anchors whose proof_file does NOT resolve on master (the #613/#615 class, at ledger scale). Enumerated by the audit's first run. Each entry is an over-claim: provenance_kind:proof with a phantom proof_file and no verification block. Resolution (per entry, theory-state — oppenheimer + cth): PROVE (write + verify the cited proof) or RECLASSIFY (provenance_kind proof -> theory|derivation). Either resolution REMOVES the entry from this register.
policy: SHRINK-ONLY. The full-ledger audit (scripts/check_anchor_manifest.py --full-ledger) HARD-FAILS if: (1) any provenance_kind:proof anchor's proof_file 404s and is NOT listed here (a NEW over-claim — blocked immediately); or (2) a listed anchor's proof_file now RESOLVES (it was fixed — remove the stale entry). The register can only lose entries. Adding an entry is a visible, reviewed commit to this file with a tracking issue — NOT a silent CI-driven baseline raise (that silent-raise is exactly what defeated the FAULT-S4-005 ratchet). This register is a burn-down list on the clock, not a permanent allowlist.
